sections.title: Töötuskindlustushüvitise saamise tingimused
sections.body: Eligibility: registered as unemployed; 12 months insurance contributions in 36 months preceding unemployment (income-based benefit).

sections.title: Töötuskindlustushüvitise suurus
sections.body: Benefit amount: 60% of average daily wage for first 100 days, then 40%. Based on 9 months of contributions.

sections.title: Töötuskindlustushüvitise maksmise periood
sections.body: Duration: 180-300 days depending on contribution history: up to 5 years = 180 days; 5-10 years = 210 days; 10+ years = 300 days. Extensions possible based on unemployment rate.

sections.title: Hüvitise maksmise peatamine
sections.body: Suspension/refusal: refusal of suitable work, failure to participate in active labour market measures without valid cause, loss of registered unemployed status.

sections.title: Koondamishüvitis
sections.body: Redundancy benefit: 1-2 months pay depending on service length (5-10 years = 1 month, 10+ years = 2 months).

sections.title: Tööandja maksejõuetuse hüvitis
sections.body: Insolvency benefit: covers unpaid wages up to 3 months + holiday pay + redundancy when employer becomes insolvent.

sections.title: Kindlustusmakse määr
sections.body: Contribution rates 2026: employee 1.6%, employer 0.8%. Employer rate for pension-age employees: 0%.

sections.title: Vaidlustamine
sections.body: Appeal Töötukassa decisions within 30 days to Töötukassa Juhatus; further to halduskohus.
